question: What must an applicant provide to evidence a common-law union?

claims.text: Statutory Declaration of Common-Law Union form (IMM 5409) and evidence of cohabitation for at least 12 continuous months
claims.quote: The applicant must submit a Statutory Declaration of Common-Law Union form [[IMM 5409 (PDF, 636.51 KB)](https://www.canada.ca/content/dam/ircc/migration/ircc/english/pdf/kits/forms/imm5409e.pdf)] and evidence of cohabitation for a period of at least 12 continuous months.

basis: The applicant's marital status is common-law, requiring proof of a common-law union.
The uploaded document 4568fffad4bd217dfae1784151cadb3f.pdf was submitted under the statutory_declaration_common_law slot.
The submission is evaluated for a Statutory Declaration of Common-Law Union (IMM 5409) and supporting cohabitation evidence.
